svg.title: G08 Put the segments on the carrier
svg.text: G08 Put the 45 wound segments onto the carrier (stand NP1-T05)
FRONT side up, stop at the bottom
Tape the 6 PT100 sensors to the
teeth 2, 17, 32 (A) and the same for B, C
Slide each segment down its groove
until it sits on the rear stop
Measure every tooth tip, front and rear:
all within 0.05 mm. Bad tooth? Swap the segment.
Slide a wedge into every slot from the front,
then bolt the clamp ring (yokes only)
